answers.core: This is about improving the editor. Editor settings like the code editor used should ideally persist between game projects, something an addon cannot achieve right now.
answers.workaround: This cannot be worked around with a few lines of script, as it would likely need various C++ APIs that are not available from the GDscript side. A GDExtension could be used, but since this affects the editor and should ideally persist between projects, a GDExtension is not ideal (Also, the editor would be applied for all contributors!)

title: Add support for embedding custom code editors within the main Godot editor
